data.one_liner: Universal video player controls compatible with any video player backend.
data.what_it_does: Provides customizable video player controls (Material, Cupertino, and desktop themes) that can be abstracted to work with different video player backends such as video_player.
use_when: You want consistent video player controls across multiple platforms.
You need custom theming for video play/pause, volume, seek bar, and fullscreen buttons.
You want to use video controls with players other than media_kit.
avoid_when: You only need a bare video player surface without any UI controls.
You are using a video player backend that does not support the required interface abstraction.
strengths: Supports multiple control themes (Material, Material Desktop, Cupertino, Adaptive).
Works across Android, iOS, web, Windows, macOS, and Linux.
weaknesses: Requires integration wrappers for specific video player backends.
Requires minimum Flutter >=3.41.0 and Dart SDK ^3.11.0.
data.setup_notes: Add the package and compatible player wrappers to pubspec.yaml.

alternatives.name: video_player
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer official, lightweight basic video playback without advanced universal controls.

alternatives.name: just_audio
alternatives.why_pick_it: If your primary focus is advanced audio playback features.
